entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Thirty-foot elemental of vines and plants, fragment of Zendikar's worldsoul, who became Nissa's companion.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who summoned Ashaya in her fight against the Eldrazi.

entities.description: Planeswalker Nissa met just after losing her connection.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis

events.summary: Ashaya does not return to the land and becomes Nissa's companion, teaching her to see and manipulate leylines.
Nissa loses her connection to Zendikar and Ashaya disappears.
events.quote: Nissa suddenly lost her connection to Zendikar, and by extension, to Ashaya, who disappeared

events.summary: Nissa frees Zendikar's soul from Ob Nixilis's hedron prison and Ashaya returns taller and more powerful.
events.quote: Ashaya returned to Nissa taller and more powerful than before

events.summary: Ashaya aids Nissa against Nahiri and her Lithoform Core.
events.quote: Ashaya later aided Nissa in her confrontation with Nahiri

relations.quote: Ashaya is an Elemental that Nissa Revane summoned on Zendikar

relations.note: He built the hedron prison she freed Zendikar from.
relations.quote: freeing Zendikar's soul from the hedron prison that Ob Nixilis had constructed
